entities.name: Siegfried Haenicke
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Siegfried Haenicke was a general in the Wehrmacht of Nazi Germany during World War II who commanded the XXXVIII Army Corps. He was a recipient of both the Pour le Mérite and Knight's Cross of the Iron Cross.
